verdict.rationale: Lever publishes a static Data API reference with endpoint sections such as applications, webhooks and audit events. It also offers a partner-gated integrator sandbox with a mirrored copy of the docs. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference with in-browser, runnable 'try it' examples. The sandbox is a separate test environment rather than an interactive reference, and the 'example apps' on the partner page are integration-building aids, not runnable reference examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
